Context: 11. Encashment of EL during L TC

5. Government servants may encash earned leave up to 10 days at the time of availing both types of LTCs i.e., 'Home town' and 'anywhere in India'. - GID (2-8), Rule 38-A.
6. Within the same block, when one type of LTC, i.e., 'Home town' or 'anywhere in India' is being availed of by the Government servant and his family members separately, encashment of leave would be restricted to one occasion only. GID (8-A), Rule 15.
